name: Acid red 33
description: Acid Red 33 (CAS 3567-66-6 ), also known as CI 17200, Azo Fuchsine, and D&C Red No. 33, is a synthetic azo dye approved for use across food, cosmetic, and industrial coloring applications. It delivers a bright, bluish-red hue with strong tinctorial strength, making it a reliable option for formulators and buyers seeking consistent batch-to-batch color performance in various manufacturing sectors. In personal care and cosmetics, D&C Red No. 33 is used to color hair dyes, lipsticks, and rinse-off products where regulatory approval for skin contact is required for consumer safety and compliance. Food-grade applications include coloring confectionery, beverages, and maraschino cherries in markets where the dye holds regulatory clearance. Textile and leather processors use CI 17200 to dye protein-based fibers. This includes materials such as wool and silk, where its acid dye chemistry bonds effectively under low-pH dyebath conditions. Paper manufacturers apply it for decorative and specialty paper coloring. Surface uniformity and shade consistency are critical in these applications. Acid Red 33 is supplied as a powder or granule, with water-soluble formulations available for liquid concentrate preparation. Food-grade and cosmetic-grade specifications are the most commercially relevant, with purity levels typically meeting FD&C or D&C certification standards depending on the target market and intended use. Technical grade is available for textile and industrial use.
